items.text: Why this topic works for this audience is written down
Main hook ≤ 14 words
At least 2 hooks from different angles (A/B)
Second hook written
Script fits the target length
Script ends with the CTA
None of the brand's banned phrases
Caption ≤ 2200 characters, hashtags ≤ 30
The promised result is one the brand can really deliver
Prices, offers and dates are current
Silences and filler sounds (um, uh, like) removed
No repeated sentence or false start left
No cut lands inside a word
No clicks or pops at cut points
Every sentence in the script is in the video
Low-confidence cuts are listed in the report
The first frame is not empty or black
The speaker's breaths and swallows aren't distracting
Jump-cut rhythm suits the brand's pace
9:16, 1080×1920, constant frame rate
No black or frozen frames
Text is in the safe area; the bottom 20% and right edge are left to the Reels UI
Long words don't overflow in captions
Caption spelling is right (names, brand, product)
Brand colours and font are right
Text doesn't cover the face (with lionstone[vision] installed)
Colour and exposure are consistent between scenes
Audio around -14 LUFS, peak ≤ -1 dBTP
Music ducks under the voice (sidechain ducking is applied)
Audio and picture are the same length and in sync
Sound effects are sparse and meaningful (at most one per 1.2 s)
The music is licensed for commercial use
Cover text fits inside the 3:4 grid crop
Cover versions are ready
caption.txt is ready
A publish date is on the calendar
Client or brand approval received
